content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Mizoram PSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Mizoram PSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Mizoram PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Mizoram PSC Junior Accounts Officer and Warden posts is 21 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Mizoram PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced by the Mizoram Public Service Commission for the posts of Junior Accounts Officer (JAO) and Warden in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years as of 01 August 2026. Age relaxation is provided for certain categories.

faq.question: Q4. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, the upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Scheduled Caste (SC) categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Accounts Officer (JAO) post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Accounts Officer (JAO) position, candidates must hold a Graduate degree from a recognized university, with a preference for a Commerce Graduate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for the Warden post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Warden post, candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The Junior Accounts Officer (JAO) will be placed in Level - 7 of the Pay Matrix, while the Warden will be placed in Level - 6 of the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Mizoram PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Examination followed by Document Verification to assess the suitability of the candidates for the advertised posts.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Mizoram PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of Mizoram PSC or the direct application link provided before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify the application fee for SC/ST candidates. However, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from paying any application fee.
